blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it ? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.
blocks.zh: 基础模型通过强化学习(RL)进行后培训,以尽量扩大具体奖励,如人与人结合、正确性或后续教学。 这个训练后的过程在计算上是密集的,有时是不稳定的,每次奖励模式改变或当我们想结合多种奖励时,都必须从零开始运行. 因此,我们问:鉴于新的奖励功能,在不实际运行RL的情况下,是否能够预测RL结果? 我们通过引入PoEM来回答这个问题。 PoEM是一个框架,用以预测RL在新的奖励职能方面的产出,使用一套已经经过其他奖励培训的模式。 首先,我们显示,如果新的奖励函数可以写成现有函数的线性组合,那么日志空间中的新策略就可以写成现有日志策略的线性组合. 令人惊讶的是,即使在奖励没有线性联系的情况下,我们观察到,来自RL训练的日志政策往往跨越了大约低级的次域奖励。 为了我们的利益,这种组合的加权系数只能利用抽样上的奖励或政策产出的依据来估计。 我们把这些观测结果变成一个算法,它采用经过后训练的模型和新的奖励功能,并且不实际运行任何附加的RL训练而来大致设定目标RL政策. 我们实验性地验证我们的方法,涵盖合成和真实的回报,包括文字和图像模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Model post-training has become a crucial step in adapting frontier models to align with human preferences and achieve desirable outcomes [ 6 , 45 , 35 ] . Unfortunately, post-training through Reinforcement Learning (RL) is expensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be redone every time the reward changes. Current heuristics, such as averaging adapter weights [ 40 , 19 , 17 ] , degrade as the number of models to be combined increases [ 51 , 52 ] , and alternative methods like best-of-N sampling [ 34 , 7 ] remain effective only within narrow regimes. Our broad motivation is to predict the RL outcome on a new reward without running RL on it. Concretely, we ask: Given a basis of single-reward post-trained adapters, can we predict the RL outcome on a new reward without training?
blocks.zh: 培训后模式已成为调整前沿模式以适应人类喜好和实现理想结果的关键步骤[6、45、35]。 不幸的是,通过强化学习(RL)进行后期培训是昂贵的,有时是不稳定的,每次奖励改变都必须重新进行. 目前的热度,如平均适配器重量[40、19、17],随着拟合并的模型数量增加[51、52]而退化,最佳N取样等替代方法[34、7]只在狭义制度中仍然有效。 我们的广泛动机是预测RL的结果 在新的奖励,而不运行RL。 具体地说,我们问:鉴于受过训练后获得单倍奖励的适配器的基础,我们能否在没有受过训练的情况下就新的奖励来预测RL结果?

blocks.en: We start by making the simple theoretical observation that if the new reward is a linear combination of the existing rewards, there is a convenient closed-form solution for the optimum policy: it is a weighted log-mixture of the base model and the policies that have been trained on the existing rewards. We further make the experimental observation that the coefficients of this log-mixture can be estimated (if unknown) through samples by performing a linear regression on the reward outcomes. This observation allows us to simulate the RL outcomes on linear combinations of existing rewards without actually running RL.
blocks.zh: 我们首先提出一个简单的理论观点,即如果新的奖励是现有奖励的线性组合,那么对于最佳政策,就有一个方便的封闭式解决方案:它是基准模型和已经接受过现有奖励培训的政策的加权对数混合. 我们进一步提出实验性意见,即可以通过对奖励结果进行线性回归,通过样品来估计这种对数混合的系数(如果未知的话)。 这种观察让我们可以模拟现有奖励的线性组合上的RL结果,而不实际运行RL.

What if we want to simulate a completely new reward? The new reward rarely decomposes linearly into a small fixed basis. Despite this, we find that the policies learned by single-reward adapters often span a much smaller behavioral space than the reward geometry suggests. Even when the adapter weight updates are nearly orthogonal, the matrix of log-ratios against the base model [ 39 ] spans far fewer effective directions. A new optimal policy can therefore lie inside this subspace even when its reward is not a linear combination of the basis rewards. The strong linearity assumption on rewards is replaced by a much weaker geometric assumption on log-policies.

blocks.en: Inspired by these observations, we propose PoEM (Product of Experts Mixing), a framework for predicting RL outcomes for new rewards from past RL trainings on a different set of rewards (Fig. 1 ). We estimate composition weights from a small set of samples scored under the new reward, using either the basis reward outputs or the basis policy log-ratios. At inference time, the policy we output is a weighted log mixture of the base model and the previously obtained policies [ 28 , 27 , 29 , 31 ] . No parameters are updated, and no additional RL run is launched.
blocks.zh: 在这些意见的启发下,我们提出了PoEM(生产专家混合),这是一个预测RL结果的框架,用于从以往RL培训中获得不同奖励(图1)。 我们估计在新奖励下得分的一小组样本的构成加权数,使用奖励产出的基础或政策基准对数。 在推论时,我们提出的政策是基准模型和以前获得的政策[28、27、29、31]的加权对数混合物。 没有更新参数,也没有启动额外的RL运行.

blocks.en: We evaluate PoEM across text and image modalities. On bases of 20 20 adapters trained with GRPO or DPO on programmatic text rewards on Qwen3-0.6B , generations from PoEM recover most of the reward gain of a directly trained RL policy on composite rewards, with an error close to the difference between two RL runs. In the general setting, a coverage score ranks in advance which held-out rewards PoEM can reach. On a basis of ten diverse public reward models adapted with PPO, generations from PoEM are closer to the directly trained RL policy than the leading single expert on 9 of 10 held-out rewards. On image generation with 13 13 adapters trained with DDPO on Stable Diffusion v1.4 , PoEM approximates a held-out RL adapter from the remaining basis. Our contributions are as follows: • We propose PoEM, an inference-time method that approximates the RL outcome on a new reward by composing existing single-reward adapters, with no further training. • We give a regression recipe for recovering composition weights, using either basis reward scores or basis log-ratios. • We find a policy space rank gap: near-orthogonal adapters span far fewer directions in log-likelihood space than in parameter space. • We validate PoEM across language and image, with comparisons to best-of- N N , and other decoding-time methods.

blocks.en: 2 Predicting RL Outcomes by Policy Composition
blocks.zh: 2 按政策构成预测RL结果

blocks.en: In this section, we propose PoEM to predict the policy that RL training on a new reward would produce, as formalized in Section 2.1 . We first consider the case in which the target reward is a linear combination of the rewards the basis policies were trained on 2.2 , and instantiate the resulting composition for autoregressive and diffusion models 2.3 . We then explain how to recover the composition weights from the basis rewards or from the basis policies alone 2.4 , and show how to check whether the basis policies cover the new reward 2.5 .

blocks.en: We test PoEM as a predictor of RL. For each target reward r tar r_{\mathrm{tar}} we train one policy π tar \pi_{\mathrm{tar}} with RL and we use it as the oracle that PoEM tries to approximate. blocks.zh: 未覆盖的奖赏因缺少方向而失败,不管用于解码的QQ\gamma. 具体来说,增加γ\gamma只有助于奖励(App.C.3)。 在P-GRPO上,由于γ\gamma从0.5增长到2,中位值覆盖了预测收益的奖励,并更接近 π tar\pi\ mathrm{tar}}(恢复0.18到0.64),而中位值发现的只有0.26,漂移了。 每一奖品的奖励在P-GRPO的0.60和P-DPO的0.39之间, 最后,扩大基础所没有的方向,不能成为它所缺乏的方向。

blocks.en: Composing also beats decoding the top expert alone. On RM-Div , PoEM is closer to the held-out expert than the top expert on 9 of 10 rewards and recovers more of its reward on 8 (0.56 against 0.44). Best-of-16 reaches a similar reward (0.60) but needs r tar r_{\mathrm{tar}} and sixteen responses per prompt, and uniform weights are as close in KL but recover less (0.50).

blocks.en: 4.4 Image diffusion models: qualitative results
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 图像传播模型:质量结果

blocks.en: A similar result holds in image diffusion models. In Fig. 5 , composing the experts trained on the other rewards reproduces the change the held-out expert makes (Target), such as more saturated colors, finer texture, and a centered subject on a blurred background. Unlike for language models, the weights are fit separately at each denoising step. Our finding is that the held-out expert’s effect lies largely within what the other experts can express (App. C.6 ), meaning that linear combinations of the conditional expectations of the policies in the basis can accurately predict the target denoiser.
blocks.zh: 图像传播模型也有类似的结果。 在图5中,培养其他奖赏方面训练的专家照搬了被搁置的专家所作的改变(目标),例如更饱和的颜色、更细的纹理以及一个背景模糊的中心主题。 与语言模型不同的是,权重在每一个去诺步骤上是分别合适的. 我们的结论是,被搁置的专家的作用主要在于其他专家能够表达的(App.C.6),这意味着在基础中,对政策的有条件期望的线性组合能够准确预测目标。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: One way to combine post-trained models is to average their weight updates in parameter space. This works when the fine-tuned checkpoints sit in a shared basin and linear mode connectivity holds [ 40 , 19 , 54 , 50 ] . Averaging helps with a few models but gets worse as more are added, since updates in different directions dilute each other. Other methods combine models at decode time by mixing their next-token logits, with no further training. DExperts [ 28 ] , contrastive decoding [ 27 ] , and proxy-tuning [ 29 ] use one positive expert and sometimes a negative one. Multi-LoRA methods [ 49 , 13 , 58 ] pick among many adapters at each token using learned gates or task tags. MOD [ 43 ] is closest to our setting. It mixes the logits of single-objective policies with user-chosen weights, which corresponds to PoEM where the weights are given. DeRa [ 31 ] interpolates between an aligned policy and the reference model to change regularization strength at decode time. PoEM differs in two ways. Its composition rule follows from the closed-form solution of KL-regularized RL (Eq. 4 ). When the weights are unknown, it fits them from the experts’ log-ratios on a small calibration set (Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 结合训练后模型的一种方法是在参数空间中平均它们的重量更新. 当经过微调的检查站坐落于一个共享的盆地和线性模式的连通性[40、19、54、50]时,这便起作用。 由于不同方向的更新会相互稀释,因此,动画对一些模型有所帮助,但随着更多的增加而变得更加糟糕。 其他方法在解码时将模型组合在一起,混合其下接的对数,不进行进一步训练. DExperts [28],对比解码 [27],代理调制 [29]使用一名正专家,有时使用负专家. Multi-LORA方法[49,13,58] 利用学到的门或任务标记,在每个信物上从许多适配器中选择. MOD[43]最接近我们的设定。 它将单目标政策的对数与用户选择的权重混合起来,这与给予权重的PoEM相对应. DeRa[31]在调和政策与参考模型之间插出在解码时间改变规范化强度. PoEM在两个方面有所不同. 其组成规则源于KL正规化RL(Eq. 4 )的封闭式解决方案. 当权重不明时,它符合专家在一套小校准(第2节)上的日志。

blocks.en: Multi-objective alignment trains one model, or a family of models, to balance several rewards with weights fixed at training time. Examples are multi-head reward models [ 48 ] , multi-objective DPO [ 56 ] , and conditional versions of DPO and PPO [ 15 , 1 ] . PoEM instead composes existing single-reward experts at decode time and fits the weights afterwards from a small calibration set, so they do not have to be chosen before training.
blocks.zh: 多目标对齐训练一种模式,或一套模式,以平衡几个奖励和训练时固定的重量. 例子有多头奖励模型[48],多目标DPO[56],以及有条件的DPO和PPO[15,1]. PoEM则在解码时间组成现有的单倍奖专家,并在之后从一个小的校准集中配齐权重,所以他们不必在训练前被选中.

blocks.en: DPO [ 39 ] shows that the KL-regularized optimum has a closed form in the reward. The trained policy’s log-ratio to the reference model is the implicit reward, up to a per-prompt constant. Prior work uses this log-ratio as one score per response, for iterative self-training [ 5 ] , for picking preference pairs by difficulty [ 37 ] , and for process reward models [ 8 ] . We use the log-ratios of all experts together and regress the target reward on them to get the weights. This works with only a few experts. Work on datamodels [ 18 ] and linear mode connectivity [ 14 ] also finds that fine-tuned models span far fewer dimensions in policy space than in parameter space.
blocks.zh: DPO [39] 显示KL规范化优化在奖励中具有封闭形式. 训练有素的政策与参考模型的对比率是隐含的奖励,最高为每时每刻。 先前的工作使用这个对数率作为每个响应的一分,用于迭代自我训练[5],通过难度选择偏好对对[37],以及流程奖励模型[8]. 我们使用所有专家的对数比例 并倒退目标奖励 他们得到重量。 这只有少数专家参与。 数据模型[18]和线性模式互联互通[14]方面的工作也发现,微调模型在政策空间的维度远少于参数空间.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The experts’ weight updates are nearly orthogonal, yet in policy space they move along only a few shared directions (Section 4.2 ). This fits the view that post-training mostly re-weights what the reference model already does. It is also why composition works. RL on a new reward can be predicted when it would move the policy in a direction the basis already has. We have only checked this on small models.
blocks.zh: 专家的权重更新几乎是正统的,但在政策空间中它们只是沿着几个共同的方向前进(第4.2节)。 这符合一种观点,即培训后大多是参照模型已经做的重新加权。 也是为什么组成是可行的。 可以预测,在新的奖励基础上的RL将推动政策的方向。 我们只检查过小模型

blocks.en: PoEM obtains a policy without training, so one can see what a candidate reward would do before paying for an RL run, and trust the preview only when coverage is high.
blocks.zh: PoEM在没有培训的情况下获得一项政策,因此在支付RL运行费用之前,人们可以看到候选人的奖励会做什么,并且只有在覆盖率高时才会相信预览.

blocks.en: RL calls the target reward on every rollout, while PoEM calls it only on a small calibration set. So RL on a reward that is expensive to evaluate, such as a large reward model, an LLM judge or a human rater, could be approximated with experts trained on cheap rewards. RM-Div does this on a small scale, and predicts each held-out 7-8B reward model from experts trained on the others. If the expensive reward depends on a direction that no cheap reward induces, coverage is low and PoEM fails. Coverage also tells us which expensive rewards a basis can stand in for.
blocks.zh: RL在每次推出时都会调用目标奖励,而PoEM则只调用小型校准集. 因此,对于一个昂贵的奖励,例如大型奖励模型、LLM法官或人评分员,可以与受过廉价奖励培训的专家相近。 RM-Div在小规模上进行这项工作,并预测每个被扣留的7-8B奖励模式来自其他专家的培训。 如果昂贵的奖励取决于没有廉价奖励诱导的方向,那么覆盖面低,PoEM失败. 报道还告诉我们,一个基础可以提供哪些昂贵的奖励。

blocks.en: Coverage shows which target rewards the current basis cannot reach, so the next expert could target the reward with the lowest coverage. Running k k experts at inference is also costly. Distilling PoEM into a single model, or starting RL from it so that training only adds the missing directions, would remove this cost. We have not tested these ideas.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面表明哪些目标奖励目前的基础无法达到,因此下一位专家可以将奖励目标定为覆盖率最低的目标。 推论中运行kk专家成本也很高. 将PoEM分解为单一模式,或从中开始RL,使训练只增加缺失的方向,可以消除这一成本. 我们没有检验这些想法。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We studied whether the outcome of RL on a new reward can be predicted from policies already trained on other rewards. When the new reward is a linear combination of the old ones, composing the experts with the combination weights, at a scale set without any new training, the RL outcome’s reward performs similarly to a second RL run does. When the new reward is not a combination, a coverage score computed from the experts ranks in advance which rewards can be reached by our basis. Rewards with low coverage stay far from the RL outcome at every γ \gamma we tried. With experts trained on reward models, PoEM is closer to the RL outcome than the reference model and the top expert on every combined reward, and coverage again ranks the held-out RMs. Together, these results suggest that a set of trained RL policies carry enough structure to compose new reward aligned behavior at inference time.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了是否可以从已经接受过其他奖励培训的政策中预测新奖励协议的结果。 当新的奖励是旧奖励的线性组合,将专家与组合权重组合在一起,在一个没有经过任何新培训的设定尺度上,RL结果的奖励表现类似于第二次RL运行。 当新的奖励不是组合时,从专家的排名中预先计算出一个覆盖分,根据我们的基础,奖励可以达到。 低覆盖率的奖励 远离RL的结果 在每一个QQ\gamma我们尝试。 与参考模型相比, PoEM更接近RL结果, 这些结果共同表明,一套经过培训的RL政策具有足够的结构,足以在推论时间构成新的奖励一致行为.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The method’s coverage is bounded by the policy space span of the chosen basis. Rewards whose target direction lies outside the span cannot be recovered, regardless of probe set size or regression strength. Practical use therefore depends on assembling a basis whose policy log-ratios cover the directions of interest, which is straightforward for taxonomies of related rewards and harder for rewards orthogonal to the available adapters. Exact composition assumes each expert is a KL-regularized optimum, with a shared reference model and β \beta . In practice, a large number of post-training runs do not include the KL term in the loss. The method is most compelling when reward evaluation is expensive or the basis is large, because best-of- N N from the base model becomes more competitive as reward-evaluation cost shrinks. We have not tested long-context generation, or whether weights fitted on one reference model carry over to another.
blocks.zh: 该方法的涵盖范围以所选依据的政策空间范围为限。 目标方向位于跨度以外的奖励无法收回,无论探测器设定大小或回归强度如何。 因此,实际用途取决于一个基础的集合,其政策记录和结果涵盖利益方向,对于相关奖励的分类学来说,这一点是直接的,对于现有的适配者来说,对正统奖励则更为困难。 准确的构成假设,每位专家都是KL规范化的优化型,具有共享的参考模型和β\β. 在实践中,大量的培训后运行不包括损失中的KL一词. 当奖励评价昂贵或基础大时,这种方法最有说服力,因为基础模型中最佳NN随着奖励评价成本的缩减而更具竞争力. 我们没有测试长文本的生成,也没有测试一个参考模型上的重量是否延续到另一个模型。

blocks.en: Table 10 holds out each of the 13 image experts in turn, on three prompts with one seed each (App. B.3 ). Composing the other twelve recovers on average 0.67 of the held-out expert’s reward gain, from 0.25 on aesthetic score to 1.07 on CLIP score. Recovery counts only the gain in the held-out reward. It ignores image quality and likeness to the held-out expert’s images. The weights are fit at every denoising step to the held-out expert’s own noise prediction, so recovery shows how much of that expert lies in the span of the others. It is not a prediction made without the expert. Span R 2 R^{2} uses the full noise prediction rather than each expert’s change to the reference model’s prediction. It is above 0.99 for every reward and does not track recovery (Spearman ρ = 0.12 \rho=0.12 across rewards). Fig. 15 shows how image rewards vary across images.
